title: ModelMetrics
description: Catalog row model-metrics 1.0.1: the held-out evaluation of the two model slots, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/stages/evaluate.py to data/derived/model-metrics.json. The surrogate is scored on an LHS draw independent of its training draw (a different seed), per output, against the canonical engine; the ONNX graphs are scored through onnxruntime, not through torch, and the parity between torch and the float32 and int8 graphs is reported; the monotonicity check is that the surrogate's P80 does not decrease as the closed-side setting opens on every machine's sweep. The autoencoder is scored by its false-alarm rate on the held-out draw and its detection rate on planted off-manifold points, beside the envelope gate's rates on the same points. Every number is computed by the evaluate stage; none is written by hand.

engine_version.description: The product version that wrote the document (format X.XX.XXX); a version other than VERSION makes the row stale.

n_train.description: The number of training points of the evaluated bundle.

n_test.description: The number of points of the independent held-out draw.

test_seed.description: The seed of the held-out Latin-hypercube draw.

r2.description: Coefficient of determination of the float32 graph against the engine, in original units.

mape_pct.description: MAPE of the float32 graph against the engine, over the points where the engine's value is not zero [%].

mape_pct_int8.description: The same MAPE for the int8 graph [%].

per_output.description: The scores of each output, keyed by its name in the bundle's output_order.

p80_monotone_vs_css.description: True when the surrogate's P80 does not fall as the closed-side setting opens on every checked curve.

torch_vs_float32_max_abs.description: The trained torch module against the float32 graph, measured by the train stage right after export.

float32_vs_int8_max_abs.description: The float32 graph against the int8 graph through onnxruntime on the held-out draw.

parity.description: The largest differences between the trained module and its exported graphs, in standardised output units.

note.description: How the surrogate was evaluated, in words.

surrogate.description: The held-out evaluation of the surrogate against the canonical engine.

false_alarm_rate.description: The share of held-out points the autoencoder marks anomalous [fraction].

n_planted.description: The number of planted off-manifold points with finite features.

detection_rate.description: The share of planted points the autoencoder marks anomalous [fraction].

envelope_false_alarm_rate.description: The share of held-out points the envelope check flags [fraction].

envelope_detection_rate.description: The share of planted points the envelope check flags [fraction].

planted.description: How the off-manifold points were planted (which inputs moved outside the training bounds, and by how much).

note.description: The alarm threshold and how the envelope check is read, in words.

anomaly.description: The held-out evaluation of the autoencoder beside the engine's envelope check.
